shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one real photograph teaching a Spanish-speaking beginner the English words THIS (the object in my own hand) and THAT (the identical object a short distance away). Natural everyday photographic detail, real material grain, soft daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark, captions, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on objects, screens and clothing. Strict first-person view from the learner's own eyes: exactly two of the learner's own forearms enter from the bottom edge, naturally attached, each hand with five natural fingers, plain charcoal-grey knit sleeves, medium-brown skin, no rings, watches or bracelets. No other people, hands, faces, mirrors or reflections. Exactly TWO identical objects of the requested kind, same model, color and size, and no other object of that kind anywhere. Both objects complete, uncropped, sharp and in focus. A first-time learner must understand the scene instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

assets.prompt:
THAT state. First-person photograph looking steeply DOWN from standing eye height at a compact patch of pale oak floorboards in a bright room; little or no wall shows. Two identical natural light-oak wooden chairs with five vertical backrest slats and a solid wooden seat, BOTH COMPLETELY inside the photo, including every leg and seat, with visible floor below every chair foot.
NEAR chair: lower-center-left, backrest toward the learner, the LEFT hand gripping the top of its backrest. It occupies at most 45 percent of the photo height and is NOT cropped by the bottom edge.
FAR chair: only 80 centimeters beyond the near chair, in the upper-center-right, facing the learner, and at least 25 percent of the photo WIDTH: large and sharp, NOT a tiny chair across a long room. The near chair still looks clearly bigger.
RIGHT hand: the forearm enters from the lower-right corner. The whole right hand, fingertip included, stays low in the photo, clearly below the far chair's lowest foot, with a wide band of empty floor between them (at least one fifth of the photo height). The straight index finger aims diagonally up and to the left at the center of the FAR chair's seat; the other fingers are curled. The fingertip never reaches between or beside the far chair's legs; no hand overlaps, touches or hides either chair.
No table, sofa, stool, bench, rug or any other furniture. The picture means: THAT chair over there, while my left hand grips THIS one.
assets.expected_description: same paired scene and strong size contrast; left hand keeps gripping the large near chair while right hand points from below at the smaller identical far chair without overlapping or touching it

change_control.old_observation: A woman seen from behind points at a window while the only chair stands off to the left, off her finger line (user report 2026-09-19); no held near chair.

supersedes_rejected_output.reason: The hand rose into the upper half and the fingertip ended between the far chair's front legs, so at phone size the finger appeared to touch the far chair; the near chair was also cut by the bottom edge.

assets.prompt: THIS state, precise edit of Image 1. Change ONLY the learner's RIGHT hand: its straight index finger now points to the left at the seat of the NEAR chair gripped by the LEFT hand, the fingertip stopping about two finger-widths short of it without touching or covering it; the other fingers stay curled. Keep everything else exactly as in Image 1: camera, light, room, surfaces, the left hand and the near chair it grips, and the FAR chair, complete, sharp and unmoved. No finger points at the far chair. No extra hands, objects, text or other changes. The picture now means: THIS chair, the one my left hand grips.
assets.expected_description: paired first-person demonstrative scene; left hand grips the near chair while right hand points at it; near chair is substantially larger than the identical far chair
